title: Prime Sieve
hints: Testing every number by trial division works but is slow. Instead, cross out the multiples of each prime you find.
Keep a std::vector<bool> composite(n + 1). For each i from 2: if it is not crossed out it is prime; cross out i*i, i*i+i, i*i+2i, ...
i * i overflows int once i passes 46340. Use long long for the inner loop variable.
